title: Making Analog Training Scale: Co-Designing Mapping, Optimizer, and Converters
abstract: arXiv:2609.36584v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Analog in-memory computing (AIMC) offers an alternative for model training by executing matrix operations directly where weights are stored. However, scaling AIMC to train modern deep models remains an open challenge due to severe hardware non-idealities, including physical weights with finite dynamic range and write granularity, analog-digital converters with finite resolution, and noisy and asymmetric updates. Guided by the insight that gradient accumulation is sensitive to precision and rounding errors, we adopt a mixed-precision training paradigm: executing forward and backward matrix multiplications in the analog domain while computing weight gradients in the digital domain. To enable scalable training, we present a holistic system-algorithm co-design that co-optimizes weight mapping to ensure well-conditioned physical and logical weight profiles, couples a preconditioned optimizer with threshold-triggered open-loop pulsing to stabi

translated_title: 让模拟训练实现规模化：映射、优化器与转换器的协同设计
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.36584v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：模拟存内计算（AIMC）通过在权重存储的位置直接执行矩阵运算，为模型训练提供了一种替代方案。然而，由于严重的硬件非理想性，将AIMC扩展用于训练现代深度模型仍然是一个悬而未决的挑战，这些非理想性包括：物理权重具有有限的动态范围和写入粒度、模数转换器分辨率有限，以及更新过程存在噪声且不对称。基于“梯度累积对精度和舍入误差敏感”这一洞察，我们采用混合精度训练范式：在模拟域中执行前向和反向矩阵乘法，同时在数字域中计算权重梯度。为了实现可扩展的训练，我们提出了一种整体性的系统-算法协同设计方案，共同优化权重映射以确保物理权重和逻辑权重处于良态分布，并将预条件优化器与阈值触发的开环脉冲相结合以稳定（摘要内容在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种混合精度训练范式与系统-算法协同设计方案，通过共同优化权重映射、预条件优化器、开环脉冲机制和模数转换器，克服模拟存内计算的硬件非理想性问题，使模拟计算能够扩展用于训练现代深度模型。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a holistic system-algorithm co-design—combining mixed-precision training with co-optimized weight mapping, a preconditioned optimizer with threshold-triggered open-loop pulsing, and converter design—that overcomes severe analog hardware non-idealities and enables analog in-memory computing to scale to training modern deep models.
